notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
description:
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Razorlash Transmogrant enters the battlefield, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Razorlash Transmogrant.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Razorlash Transmogrants, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
